name: blanket-disallow
description: Clean site whose robots.txt disallows everything for every crawler. The audit obeys robots, so only robots.txt is fetched.

expected.notes: blanket_disallow critical. Per dedupe row 2 the per-tier robots findings fold into it. Every page-level check must be not_evaluated with reason robots_disallow (no finding except where the schema says an info note is worth emitting). This fixture verifies the audit never fetches a disallowed page.
